title: The Gallery House
cardAlt: Stone and shingle-sided home at sunset with lit windows
heroAlt: Stone and shingle-sided home at sunset with lit windows
paragraphs: Designed for a family balancing demanding medical careers with a passion for the arts, the Gallery House brings together the needs for connection, creativity, and quiet retreat. Thoughtfully arranged spaces support the rhythms of family life while offering light-filled rooms for artistic expression and quieter corners for rest and solitude.

Natural stone and dark shingle siding establish a grounded, timeless exterior, while gabled dormers and circular windows introduce subtle architectural character. Inside, wide-plank wood flooring carries through the foyer, where an open staircase pairs a rich dark wood railing with crisp white balusters. A dramatic two-story living room frames the surrounding woodland through a wall of soaring windows, blurring the boundary between indoors and out and reinforcing the home's sense of tranquility.

gallery.alt: Entry foyer with a white front door, open staircase with dark wood rail and white balusters, and a hall leading to a bright room
Kitchen with pale gray inset cabinets, a large quartz island, a copper range hood and a built-in stainless refrigerator
Two-story living room with a wall of tall windows facing the woods, wall paneling and wide-plank wood floors
Bedroom with a vaulted ceiling, round window and ceiling fan
Primary bath with a soaking tub under a round window, glass shower with patterned tile niche and marble-look floor
